name: Before The College Dropout
description: Before breaking through as a solo artist, Kanye West spent years as a producer and rapper in Chicago's underground scene. As a member of the Go Getters alongside GLC and Timmy G, he recorded a series of tracks throughout the late 90s and early 2000s that laid the groundwork for his eventual mainstream debut.

comps.name: World Record Holders
comps.description: Re-mix and remaster of every single song done by Kanye's 90s rap group, the Go Getters, even including exclusive freestyles and snippets in live recordings.

name: The College Dropout
description: Kanye West's debut studio album, released February 10, 2004, challenged the gangsta rap dominance of the time with soulful production, chipmunk soul samples, and introspective lyricism about education, race, and religion. The album was accompanied by a series of mixtapes — the Freshmen Adjustment series — that compiled his work from the previous years.

name: Late Registration
description: Kanye's sophomore album, released August 30, 2005, expanded his sonic palette with orchestral arrangements crafted alongside Jon Brion. The album debuted at number one and produced numerous hit singles, cementing Kanye as one of hip-hop's most ambitious artists.

comps.name: The Good, The Bad & The Ugly
comps.description: An imaginary collab album between Kanye, Common and Consequence set in 2006, using non-album songs from around the era and adding the corresponding missing artists to each song.

comps.name: Late Registration [RM]
comps.description: Simple remaster of the released album, along with a few extras.

name: Late Orchestration
description: A live album recorded at London's Brixton Academy during the Late Registration tour, featuring stripped-back orchestral performances of Kanye's songs. The sparse, intimate arrangements revealed a new dimension of the material.

comps.name: Late Orchestration
comps.description: EP-length comp reworking orchestral production into a few LR tracks to recreate the style of their respective Late Orchestration performances, in studio quality, via incorporating various organic instruments and vocal effects to sound like live tracks.

comps.name: Late Orchestration
comps.description: Remastered version of the live album Late Orchestration, with crowd vocals removed and improved mixing.

name: Graduation
description: Released September 18, 2007, Graduation marked a dramatic shift toward stadium-ready synth-pop and electronic sounds influenced by Daft Punk and European electronic music. Its release coincided with a high-profile sales battle against 50 Cent's Curtis, which Kanye won convincingly.

comps.name: Master Class
comps.description: A completely random reimagination of what could have been Kanye's 3rd studio album if he hadn't swiftly changed from his orchestral LR style to the stadium synthy sound of Graduation, built using LR-era and pre-Grad release songs with various production and verse changes.

comps.name: Senior Year
comps.description: A soulful, grand rework of Graduation to emphasize not just the synth sounds of the release album but also incorporate various orchestral and soulful elements influenced from the samples. A lot more fleshed out as a listening experience than release.

comps.name: Graduation Reworked
comps.description: Graduation with fairly basic new and extra synths added to give it a slightly grander feel, with some other changes like features sprinkled throughout.

comps.name: Graduation: Rising Stars
comps.description: A semi-playlist comp comprising edits by the creator and from BSB Dante's and yak's Graduation comps, compiling album songs along with tracks from mixtapes and features, all incorporated into a new shuffled tracklist to flesh out the sound of the era further.

name: 808s & Heartbreak
description: Released November 24, 2008, in the wake of his mother's death and a broken engagement, 808s & Heartbreak was a radical departure — a minimalist, autotune-driven meditation on grief and isolation that influenced a generation of artists and helped birth modern emo rap.

comps.name: 808s & Heartbreak (Rework)
comps.description: Very high quality 808s comp that sprinkles in various new prod elements and additions inspired by both the VH1 Storytellers and the HollyWood Bowl performances, without using any material directly from those shows, keeping a separate and unique listening experience.

comps.name: Heartbreak V2
comps.description: An old 808s rework that leans into a more somber and colder sound direction, focusing on the realistic aspects of heartbreak from a failed relationship through added production, voice message skits and a stripped back tracklist.

name: Child Rebel Soldier
description: Child Rebel Soldier was a supergroup formed by Kanye West, Lupe Fiasco, and Pharrell Williams in 2007. The trio released a handful of tracks and snippets that hinted at a full collaborative project that never officially materialized.

comps.name: Child Rebel Soldier
comps.description: A short but very concise reimagining of what an era-accurate version of an album/mixtape released by the Child Rebel Soldier supergroup would sound like. Contains tweaked versions of released CRS songs as well as recreations of snippets, reworks of beats from older eras, and entirely new instrumentals based on new samples.

name: Good Ass Job
description: Good Ass Job was the working title for Kanye's fifth studio album, in development from 2009 through early 2010. Originally conceived as a boom-bap counterpoint to the synths of Graduation, the project evolved through numerous iterations before ultimately transforming into My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy.

comps.name: Good Ass Job
comps.description: Perhaps one of the most infamous comps of the 2023-24 era, responsible for the renaissance of the GAJ era. The concept was a B-side to MBDTF, with every major GAJ leak receiving grand overhauls and reproduced elements to match MBDTF's level of greatness. Despite some extract and mixing issues, this remains one of the greatest comps and drops of all time.

comps.name: Good Ass Job
comps.description: While arriving during the GAJ saturation era, the ideas and execution arguably rival Pastelle's GAJ, though rather than editing well-known songs, the comp approaches mostly pre-VMAs material. Dawgy Style colorizes songs by adding new sections, segments, beatswitches, skits, and many other diverse changes.

comps.name: The 4 Seasons: W.S.S.F
comps.description: B Side to Santino's GAJ, noticeably dropped much later with an increase in quality. The unusual and interesting song selection reaches the amount of uniqueness and obscurity Santino is known for, with various new creative changes and production.

comps.name: MADVILLAINZ
comps.description: A very unique take on an imagined collab album from MADVILLAINZ, the real life obscure trio formed between Madlib, MF DOOM and Kanye himself. Features a combination of 2009 material from DOOM's BORN LIKE THIS album and Kanye's scrapped GAJ album.

comps.name: Good Ass Job
comps.description: Fairly short alternative take where the sound and influence of 808s take the spotlight rather than boom bap or synth pop. Features various production reworks of lesser known GAJ tracks, some more drastic than others.

comps.name: Good Ass Job
comps.description: One of the cleanest and most impressive new GAJ reworks to come out recently. Each song receives very special treatment and given lots of attention to detail that makes each track feel distinct and progress like a real released song would.

comps.name: g00d a$$ job
comps.description: GAJ rework turning the album into a synthy pop-inspired record released in early 2010. Has a balanced track selection of MBDTF album track edits implementing various demo elements and LP5 scraps. Has okay-ish mixing at times but very impressive production.

comps.name: Good Ass Job
comps.description: Features a fairly unique selection of GAJ songs encompassing not just lesser known tracks, but also pre-VMAs and even some non-Kanye songs. While reworks on the more unique song selections are very neat, some others feel fairly minimal.

comps.name: Good Ass Job
comps.description: SimpleJosh-style remasters and restructures of various well-known GAJ leaks, overall just being a pack of clean, polished takes on the source material. There is some slight reworking on the OG MBDTF songs that go along well with Josh's clean mixing and integration style.

comps.name: Good Ass Job
comps.description: Very high quality collection of GAJ songs, compiling only some of the most finished material to truly reconstruct what a decent album could have dropped instead of MBDTF. Despite having some reworks, they all are very cohesive in creating a realistic envisioning of the era.

name: My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy
description: Released November 22, 2010 following Kanye's post-Taylor Swift exile to Hawaii, MBDTF is widely regarded as his magnum opus — a maximalist, grandiose epic featuring contributions from some of the biggest names in music and production, with Kanye pouring everything into a statement album.

comps.name: My Beautiful Dark Twisted Symphony
comps.description: 5 songs from Kanye's magnum opus with new string arrangements meant to enhance the listening experience and offer a more cinematic atmosphere to Kanye West's most lavish project to date.

comps.name: MBDTF (Deluxe Edition)
comps.description: Imagining of a deluxe edition to the released album, using confirmed tracks as well as other popular LP5 tracks, adding vocals and production to fit the maximalist MBDTF soundscape.

comps.name: MBDTF (Mike Dean Live Inspired)
comps.description: A simple comp that adds basic Mike-Dean-style synths to all of the tracks on the original released album, helping add a mild touch of grandness to the album without overdoing it or adding anything that might stand out.

comps.name: Good Ass Job
comps.description: Originally intended to be a GAJ comp, but the team agreed to put this in MBDTF era instead. Features various remasters and reproduced elements for a variety of MBDTF-era songs and some Good Friday tracks.

comps.name: Good Ass Job
comps.description: Very classic and high quality LP5 comp based on the Donda's Boy rumor, with every song drawn out with intros, outros and features to all be 10 minutes long. Has an hour long Runaway bonus. Most notably used to be featured on the sidebar of the r/Kanye subreddit.

comps.name: Good Kid, Twisted Fantasy
comps.description: Toasty-style mashup album of MBDTF and GKMC, mixing together prod elements and vocals from both albums to create a hybrid experience. Got covered by multiple news outlets and even a reaction from Anthony Fantano.

name: Watch The Throne
description: Released August 8, 2011, Watch The Throne was a collaborative album between Kanye West and JAY-Z, celebrating luxury, Black excellence, and the complexities of being two of the most successful figures in hip-hop. The album was recorded mostly in suites of high-end hotels around the world.

comps.name: Return Of The Throne
comps.description: The world's first proper WTT2/WTTII comp, imagining a realistic sequel to WTT released in 2013 with sonics similar to JAY-Z's Magna Carta…Holy Grail album, featuring reworks and recreations of tracks from that album as well of WTT/CS/TGFD era tracks.

comps.name: Watch The Throne (Deluxe) [RM]
comps.description: Simple remaster of the released album.

comps.name: Black Excellence
comps.description: Solo-Kanye WTT. The songs have new verses from both Kanye and other features to fill in the empty spots where JAY-Z was, making this a fun neat project of alternative takes on the songs from the album.

name: Thank God For Drugs
description: Thank God For Drugs refers to the OG / pre-release version of what would become Yeezus. During 2012-2013, Kanye worked on an abrasive, experimental project featuring a unique blend of industrial sounds, psychedelic samples, and avant-garde production that differed significantly from the final released album.

comps.name: Golden Head
comps.description: A pack of finished enough tracks from the original iteration of Nari's upcoming CULT comp. Golden Head is a CHIRAQ-style general overhaul of a handful of lesser known TGFD songs, featuring tons of different beatswitches, added production, sounds, samples, added verses, and so much more, creating one of the most unique and exciting experiences in LP6 as of late.

comps.name: Thank God For Drugs
comps.description: One of the most legendary and classic rework comps ever. SimpleJosh's TGFD is a massive 20+ track long overhaul of everything people knew about TGFD as an era back in the day (2020) and gave it a new sound, aesthetic, vibe, all the while achieving very impressive production and recreation feats. A must-listen for anybody getting into the comm for the first time.

comps.name: Thank God For Drugs
comps.description: About 1 year after SimpleJosh's legendary TGFD rework, the community decided to use his comp as a backbone and build an entirely new community comp. Adds plenty of new production with some trap influences, covering slightly more content than SJ's due to it coming out at a later time. Won Comp of The Year at the annual Yammy's.

comps.name: Black American Psycho
comps.description: TGFD comp featuring various reworks and recreations of songs based on established and newly surfaced material from the era along with samples from the movie American Psycho. Contains a slightly bigger variety of new leaks and alt versions that weren't there when the other classics were made.

comps.name: Thank God For Drugs (Akimbo's Cut)
comps.description: Akimbo's personal cut of the community comp, stripping down most of the tracklist and even some edits and polishing their mixing even more. Can be considered an alternative version of the community comp.

comps.name: Lost Yeezus (Revised)
comps.description: A comp done ON another comp, based on SimpleJosh's comp of the same name. Addresses some shortcomings by including a few new edits based on TGFD content and info applied over Yeezus album tracks, altering or redoing some of the original edits as well.

comps.name: Lost Yeezus V2
comps.description: The spiritual successor and update to Josh's classic TGFD rework comp. Focuses on picking the more atmospheric and airy sounds present in the leaks as opposed to the chaotic abrasive sound Yeezus is known for. One of if not the best way to experience LP6 leaks.

name: Yeezus
description: Released June 18, 2013, Yeezus was a deliberately abrasive, minimalist album that shocked listeners and critics with its industrial, punk-influenced sound. Produced in a whirlwind creative sprint with Rick Rubin stripping back many tracks at the last minute, the album pushed hip-hop into confrontational new territory.

comps.name: God Wants You
comps.description: Complete re-envisioning of Yeezus, warping the album into a horrorcore, experimental collage containing multiple samples from the Twin Peaks show, as well as even more added production that still retains elements of release but adding even more abrasion and chaos. Possibly the best transformation of the released album by far.

comps.name: Yeezus Remastered
comps.description: Still preserving the release album as a framework but sprinkling in various leaks and production from OG leaks, never too much that it feels like just another TGFD comp. A perfect line to walk for people seeking an experience that still feels like Yeezus but just ever so slightly TGFD.

comps.name: Not For Sale
comps.description: DJ GOTHFUKKER's debut comp, a take on Yeezus with grittier production reminiscent of industrial sounds and different arrangements to make the songs sound more complete and unique.

comps.name: Yeezus (Extended)
comps.description: Despite being labelled an extended comp, this comp curates various leaks and other editors' edits tastefully to make a Yeezus experience that isn't too different from the original but also not so similar as to make it boring. Just a perfect balance of everything.

comps.name: Mourn For The Weak
comps.description: Remix of Yeezus in the style of experimental hip-hop group Death Grips, featuring completely redone beats with abrasive and chaotic production that feels like DG themselves with a touch of Kanye's influence.

comps.name: Yessiah
comps.description: Reimagining of Yeezus with a variety of production overhauls to build upon the core ideas of the songs or bring them to entirely different directions, sometimes adding onto the abrasion, sometimes replacing the beat entirely with a new sampled beat.

name: Cruel Winter [V1]
description: Cruel Winter was a proposed G.O.O.D. Music collaborative album that was announced in 2012 and went through multiple iterations. The V1 era refers to the material from around 2014 that was recorded with a particular sound distinct from the later V2 sessions.

comps.name: Cruel Winter
comps.description: Double-disc comp with each disc reworking a few songs from CWv1 and CWv2 respectively. This entry regards the CWv1 disc exclusively. The disc fully fleshes out the few songs we know from the era through new prod as well as new features.

comps.name: Cruel Winter (2014)
comps.description: A more extensive compilation of 2014 CW tracks with various QoL changes and new features/verses to flesh them out into a real G.O.O.D. Music project from the time period.

name: Yeezus 2
description: Yeezus 2 refers to the unreleased follow-up project to Yeezus worked on throughout 2014, featuring various experimental and melodic tracks as well as Paul McCartney collaborations. The era is closely tied to the So Help Me God and SWISH eras that would follow.

comps.name: SENSATIONAL
comps.description: A collection of various rarely edited OG LP7 songs, mostly Y2 era, all reworked enough to make them sound as finished as other released LP7 songs. Features 2 entire discs for the full comp alongside over a dozen demos and unfinished scraps. A great introduction for anyone who wants to do a deep dive into the expansive collection of unreleased 2014 Kanye.

comps.name: Yeezus II
comps.description: An only 8-track long Y2 comp that covers almost all the aspects presented by songs from the era: OG TLOP, Paul McCartney, Yeezus/Rodeo-like experimental abrasive and more, now with new production, structures, verses and ideas to make them more polished and release ready. The most encompassing and perfect Y2 project by far.

comps.name: Yeezus II
comps.description: A more traditional Y2 rework that focuses more on delivering an OG LP7 experience rather than showcase too much of the rough, unfinished aspect of the era. Contains windy's own edits alongside some custom edits of other major projects. Decent neat listen for those who value finished over unfinished.

comps.name: Yeezus 2 (hc's Version)
comps.description: The first proper Y2 comp to drop in the modern era. A much more realistic and era-accurate version compared to comps that came before it, only using leaks and full versions specifically made within the time period. The first Y2 comp to really explore the era beyond just being early old versions of LP7 songs.

name: So Help Me God
description: So Help Me God was the next stage of Kanye's unreleased LP7, transitioning from the raw experimentation of Yeezus 2 into a more polished, trap-influenced sound with pop sensibilities. Paul McCartney's influence on several tracks brought an acoustic dimension to what was otherwise an aggressive project.

comps.name: CHIRAQ
comps.description: An extremely unique rework/remix of various OG LP7 songs, jam-packed with new added production, entire new beatswitches and new samples incorporated across every single track. The debut (finished) project by Nari, cementing his style as being chaotic and at times messy but extremely creative nonetheless.

comps.name: So Help Me God
comps.description: A spiritual V3 to his YII comp and a V2 to his MGIA comp. A diverse and expansive rework of OG LP7 material in general, taking advantage of SHMG's vague perception to nail in the classic interpretation of the album being a combination of everything Y2, SHMG itself and SWISH has to offer.

comps.name: So Help Me God: Angels
comps.description: The sophomore and latest project by Miracles Team / Magik & Co. The first comp to reinterpret SHMG into a more accurate view of a pop, trap-leaning album with some synthy and acoustic hints due to Paul McCartney's influence. Focuses on reproducing several elements and remastering vocals across many tracks.

comps.name: So Help Me God V2
comps.description: One of if not the most classic OG LP7 reworks. A short, only 9-track long comp that applies various changes and overhauls to a very classic song selection that leans heavily into the aggressive, dark, abrasive sound that SHMG was originally thought to have.

comps.name: So Help Me God V3
comps.description: A SimpleJosh-style vanilla polish and remaster of various SHMG era leaks to be as listenable and enjoyable as possible with very few new added production. By far the best way so far to experience what OG LP7 is at its core.

comps.name: So Help Me God
comps.description: Focuses on combining and slightly polishing various leaks specifically unique to SHMG, aiming to make an experience that, despite feeling rough, reflects and truly shows the real colors of SHMG based exactly on the leaks made during the time period.

name: SWISH
description: SWISH was the next evolution of Kanye's unreleased LP7, developed throughout 2015-2016 with a sleeker, more futuristic sound. Heavily influenced by Darren King and DJDS production, the project sat somewhere between the rawness of SHMG and the mainstream polish of the eventual release, The Life Of Pablo.

comps.name: SWISH
comps.description: One of the best and most impressive comps to drop in modern time. A concise, only 12-track long comp that closes in its distance between being a fanmade comp to being an entirely new album, featuring SWISH songs with overhauled production that not just echoes the real sonics of the era but also introduces new elements, samples, segments, beatswitches and more.

comps.name: WAVES
comps.description: One of the first major SWISH reworks of the modern era. A 19-track rendition of SWISH that leans heavily into the idea that it was an OG version of TLOP, being tracklisted and stylized similar to the release album all the while adapting some unreleased songs and adding production that reflects the actual leaks.

comps.name: SWISH (poofartpoo Edition)
comps.description: One of the first if not the first major SWISH comp in the comm. Essentially a 10+ track long comp of various TLOP songs with new synthy futuristic production added and some OG elements here and there to simulate what SWISH could have been. Despite being built around an ancient vision of SWISH, still a high quality alt-TLOP experience.

comps.name: SWISH
comps.description: Updated version of bingboop's personal SWISH comp, aiming for a sound more aligned with the earlier Darren King and DJDS production as well as some obscure LP7 cuts. Being prolly the biggest LP7 LARPER in the comm, this is inadvertedly the best experience for getting the true core and sonics of the era.

comps.name: SWISH
comps.description: One of the first proper comps done on the era, polishing and restructuring other QoL changes on full leaks from the era. One of Akimbo's first attempts at adding production via new drums and incorporating elements from alt versions. Emphasizes what's unique about the era rather than reworking it massively.

name: 808s & Heartbreak: Live At The Hollywood Bowl
description: In 2015, Kanye performed 808s & Heartbreak in full at the Hollywood Bowl with a full orchestra, choir, and special guests. The performance was eventually documented through leaked CDQ recordings that captured the event's sweeping emotional grandeur.

comps.name: 808s & Orchestration
comps.description: A classic, old 808s comp that incorporates various original as well as extracted orchestral and guitar elements into the original album, inspired by the Hollywood Bowl, creating a maximalist, grand experience. Despite the files to the performance having already been leaked, this project is still one of the most impressive projects.

comps.name: 808s & Heartbreak: Live At The Hollywood Bowl
comps.description: A remaster and polish of all the leaked CDQ files of the Hollywood Bowl performance, containing various QoL edits and changes that create the best versions of all the leaks combined. Also includes edits of some SWISH-era Caroline Shaw collaborations. The best way to experience the performance as of now.

name: The Life Of Pablo
description: Released February 14, 2016, The Life Of Pablo was a sprawling, gospel-influenced album that Kanye continued to update and modify after its streaming debut. The album was famously in flux, with multiple different versions circulating as Kanye added and removed tracks.

comps.name: My God Is Awesome
comps.description: An ACTUAL TLOP rework, the spiritual successor to windy's YII and the blueprint/predecessor to his So Help Me God project. A collection of both TLOP released songs and leaks envisioning what the album would have looked like if it takes more after its previous real life vision, SWISH.

comps.name: Ultralight Beam
comps.description: First real attempt at transforming the TLOP era, with an all-new tracklist combining both released songs with OG LP7 songs and adds production, features, beatswitches, and other new elements on almost all the tracks to create a unique, guitar-influenced hip-hop experience.

comps.name: The Life Of Pablo (Radikal Redux)
comps.description: TLOP comp that selects changes made by BlockaShotya's Extended Edition and Dorian Ye's The Life of Paul and combines them with the creator's own personal edits to create the most optimal TLOP experience as possible.

comps.name: The Life Of Paul
comps.description: Early TLOP rework from 2016 that provides alternative versions of each released TLOP song, albeit with only slight changes like restructure of segments or new intros/outros. One of the most popular classic comps.

comps.name: The Life Of Pablo (Extended Edition)
comps.description: One of the earliest fanmade comps to surface on the internet. An extended comp that expands on released songs with sample intros/outros, added features and other new instrumental segments. Notable for adding and incorporating a much more diverse selection of content.

comps.name: The Death Of Pablo & The Legacy Of Pablo
comps.description: One of the most classic and oldest Yedits out there. The Death of Pablo is a fan album taking snippets of TLOP to distort and transform them beyond recognition into a noisy, haunting reimagining of the album, inspired by a 4chan user's nightmare. Gained notoriety from being reviewed by various music publications.

name: Cruel Winter [V2]
description: The V2 era of Cruel Winter refers to the material recorded in 2016-2017 for the revived G.O.O.D. Music project, with a distinctly different sound from the 2014 sessions — incorporating elements from the Daytona and Blobama era that Pusha T was developing around the same time.

comps.name: Cruel Winter
comps.description: Double-disc comp with each disc reworking a few songs from CWv1 and CWv2 respectively. This entry regards the CWv2 disc exclusively. The disc fully fleshes out the few songs we know from the era through new prod as well as new features.

comps.name: Cruel Winter (2017)
comps.description: A collection of polished and tweaked CWv2 tracks and some OG Daytona / Blobama songs that are fit for CWv2. Josh also went the extra mile to edit some 2015-2017 Pusha T material that highly likely also would have gotten on this album. Also features some updated edits from his other projects.

name: TurboGrafx16
description: TurboGrafx16 refers to a collection of unreleased Kanye tracks from around 2017, named after the retro video game console, characterized by their futuristic trap sound and the heavy influence of producer Keyon Christ. The era has seen significant development in community understanding and editing over the years.

comps.name: TurboGrafx16: MITUS
comps.description: The winner of the first 1-week comp contest hosted in Yedits. TG16: MITUS is a short, only 7-track long explosive overhaul of a handful of Turbo songs, all in the style of Keyon Christ. The comp incorporates a huge variety of samples from Keyon's beats, resulting in a comp that sounds like nothing that came before it.

comps.name: ULTRA!
comps.description: Minerva's final and most recent iteration of her Turbo comp series. Despite being a redone of PC-Engine with very little carryover, ULTRA! is a cohesive and expansive coverage of the best the era has to offer, honing into the futuristic trap sound whilst polishing them and giving them unique spins. Nevertheless does it best.

comps.name: PC Engine: TurboGrafx-16 V2
comps.description: The update and second iteration of Minerva's Turbo comp series, now with much more extensive and polished production. The comp consists of 3 discs, each of the 2 discs covering about 10 songs and the 3rd one being a tracklist combining both of the first 2 discs.

comps.name: TurboGrafx16 (poofartpoo Edition)
comps.description: One of the most popular and one of 2 major classic TurboGrafx16 reworks from back in the day. A synth-filled experience with various video game samples and sound effects sprinkled throughout. Remains a very influential comp, paving the way for future projects of the era to do more experimenting and sampling.

comps.name: TurboGrafx16: Indigo Sound Remastered
comps.description: Remaster of SimpleJosh's legendary Indigo Sound comp. Aims to fix some of the lacking audio aspects of the original comp and help make the changes Josh applied to the songs sound more audible and prominent.

comps.name: TurboGrafx16: Indigo Sound
comps.description: One of the most infamous classic TurboGrafx16 reworks. Also one of the projects to solidify SimpleJosh as one of the greatest editors in the community. The first major effort to make Turbo into something tangible more than a handful of leaks. Despite much more impressive reworks now, this comp still plays a massive influence in giving Turbo its original identity.

name: Wolves
description: Wolves refers to the era surrounding the Wolves/FML sessions, developed as part of The Life Of Pablo's creation, featuring a distinct atmospheric sound and several collaborations that were eventually cut or reworked for the final album.

comps.name: For All The Wolves
comps.description: Mashup comp of songs by both Kanye and Drake, not necessarily focused on any era in particular but just being creative and fun. Despite the mashup status, the compilation features some added production and ideas that don't go too crazy or off-track. Notably the first Wolves comp, despite not being a proper one, to break the 'Wolves curse.'

name: LOVE EVERYONE
description: Love Everyone was a project Kanye began working on in Wyoming in 2018, alongside ye and Kids See Ghosts. Characterized by a minimalist, rustic aesthetic and raw emotional lyricism, the project was shelved before completion but spawned some of the community's most beloved comp work.

comps.name: Love Everyone
comps.description: Freshly released LE rework balanced around alt prod versions of released tracks and obscure picks from Wyoming sessions, all to deliver a great, enjoyable rework of the era.

comps.name: Love Everyone: Spirits
comps.description: Classic rework of LE with a mixture of slight tweaks and total song overhauls, containing stripped down and reordered elements to make a seamless experience that leans on the barebones, slight horrorcore aspect of the era.

comps.name: Love Everyone
comps.description: LE comp focusing on the spiritual songs along with the empathetic songs that actually fit the title LE but also the most psychedelic sounding songs. Very cohesive sounding and has no mumble other than 1 song.

comps.name: Love Everyone
comps.description: Personal LE comp designed to be minimalistic to drive home the messages and thoughts Kanye had brewed up during this era. Contains a brilliant stripped back Violent Crimes edit that gives more weight to Chance's verse.

comps.name: Love Everyone
comps.description: 7-track comp imagining what a version of Love Everyone from before the TMZ rant would look like. Contains QoL improvements as well as minimal additions resulting in recreations of well-known, yet usually untouched ideas of the era.

comps.name: Yedits Presents: Love Everyone
comps.description: 4th installment of the YP series. Has several beat overhauls, song recreations and new verses/features spread across 20+ tracks by several top editors at the time. Contains an amazing SimBap rework but otherwise can be a bit bloated and questionable at times.

name: ye
description: ye was Kanye's eighth studio album, released June 1, 2018, created in five days in Wyoming following a period of intense controversy. The album's raw, introspective six tracks explore themes of mental health, relationships, and self-reflection. Multiple tracks exist in alternate versions from the Wyoming sessions.

comps.name: Omari (V1 + V2)
comps.description: Comp based around the Wyoming sessions, containing outstanding edits with production overhauls, added features and more. A full expression of what ye could have been if it went in a much more maximalist route. Despite being updated with new bonuses and different mixing, some people might prefer V1.

comps.name: Graveyard (1st Anniversary Edition)
comps.description: Wyoming era comp centered around a merge of dark vibes with fun sampley elements like its LE counterpart, Peace & Love. Very cinematic and unique experience that best mimics the sampley trait of the Wyoming eras.

comps.name: Be Here Now
comps.description: A rework of ye that leans heavily onto the minimalistic and folklore aesthetics of LE, creating a unique selection of tracks with altered beats and more stripped back production. Despite not receiving much attention, there are still ideas and executions that can be used as inspiration.

comps.name: Love.
comps.description: Personal LP8 cut that serves as an alt Omari experience by including several edits directly or derived from Lionel's comp with audio tweaks throughout.

comps.name: ye
comps.description: Classic ye comp infamous for the 'Ghost Town/Violent Crimes but it will make you ascend to the 4th dimension' edits on YouTube with heavy usage of synths, samples, live performances and a complete overhaul in vibe for the 2 last songs of the album.

comps.name: ye (Mike Dean Inspired Edit)
comps.description: Complete rework of ye that adds Mike Dean-like synths to each song, giving the usually short album a much more atmospheric and fulfilling feel.

comps.name: All That Matters
comps.description: Megamix of LP8 material with edits that don't break out of the original sound. Very good way to know the macro-era at ground level.

name: KIDS SEE GHOSTS
description: Kids See Ghosts was a collaborative album between Kanye West and Kid Cudi, released June 8, 2018, as part of the Wyoming sessions. A dense, psychedelic project packed with abstract production and emotionally raw performances from both artists.

comps.name: Kids See Ghosts 2
comps.description: Fantastic comp imagining a second Kids See Ghosts album. Backed up by amazing instrumentals though verse selection maybe off in some places.

comps.name: In The Sunken Place
comps.description: High quality BSB Dante extension, with sample showcases, added non-album tracks and any extra official elements available around the era. Contains both ye and KSG material.

name: Job Well Done
description: Job Well Done refers to a proposed collaboration album between Kanye West and Chance the Rapper from the Wyoming sessions, featuring a handful of tracks that showcased the two artists' complementary styles in a gospel-influenced, sample-heavy sound.

comps.name: Job Well Done
comps.description: The first fully fledged out rework of this often ignored era, recreating and expanding on the material we have from it and other early Yandhi songs, adding production, verses and restructures where needed.

comps.name: Good Ass Job
comps.description: Old and short 8 track rework of GAJ18 songs or Chance-related 2018 songs. Simple, but neat and very high-quality.

name: Yandhi [V1]
description: Upon hearing the beat to "Hurricane" during sessions for Good Ass Job (2018), Kanye became inspired to create a whole new album titled Yandhi. With the album's concept in his mind, Kanye and his producers began frenzied work as they developed multiple new songs throughout September 2018, aiming for a September 29 release date. As they did not meet this deadline, Kanye went to Uganda to conduct further work on the album, but delayed it indefinitely on November 13.

comps.name: Yandhi
comps.description: Yandhi rework aiming to create a polished finished project out of the known Yandhi material, making QoL and production changes where necessary. One of the best, most focused Yandhi comps in recent time.

tracklist.title: The Storm
tracklist.feat: Kid Cudi, XXXTENTACION, Ty Dolla $ign & Ant Clemons

tracklist.title: Alien
tracklist.feat: Jaden Smith, 2 Chainz, Kid Cudi & Quavo

tracklist.feat: Ty Dolla $ign, Ant Clemons, 070 Shake, The-Dream, Desiigner & Kid Cudi

tracklist.feat: Ty Dolla $ign, Ant Clemons, Daniel Caesar, The-Dream, Teyana Taylor & DMX

tracklist.title: Law Of Attraction
tracklist.feat: Ant Clemons, CyHi, Sunday Service Choir & Kenny G

editors: jimboiscool — for an insane amount of feedback and help

comps.name: Grandhi V2
comps.description: Grand envisioning of Yandhi with new production, added verses and complete overhauls to make every track maximalist and packed to the fullest.

comps.name: Yandhi: Revised Edition
comps.description: Comp containing a balance of complete and purist edits of each song. Has transitions and a clear consistent theme. One of the most downloaded comps ever and and a good way to listen to a finished and accurate Yandhi.

comps.name: SpaceX
comps.description: Space-themed Yandhi comp by JonJeffJonJon. Filled with luscious synths, rearrangements and other reworked elements.

name: Yandhi [V2]
description: After Kanye delayed Yandhi indefinitely, he began working with record producer Timbaland to create "more healing music" for the album. Shortly after the announcement of the delay, Kanye underwent a sudden and dramatic conversion towards born-again evangelical Christianity, debuting the Sunday Service Choir at the start of 2019. The creation of the choir coincided with the songs on Yandhi taking a new Christian lyrical focus. Eventually, the album would morph into the thoroughly Christian JESUS IS KING by mid-2019.

comps.name: Yedits Presents: Yandhi
comps.description: A long awaited revival of the YP comp series, focusing on transforming mostly Yandhi V2 material into finished club bangers.

tracklist.title: I Love It
tracklist.editors: Jeen, NormalWorld & IcyEdits · add. mimi, hc & Milan

editors: Organised & run by Jeen · Co-organisers: hc, JonJeffJonJon & NobodyIsNari · Mixed by hc

comps.name: Healing
comps.description: Imagining of a short Wyoming sessions style collab album between Kanye and Ant released in early 2019, expanding on the demos from the Yandhi V2 era with added production and vocals where needed.

name: JESUS IS KING
description: Released October 25, 2019, Jesus Is King was Kanye's ninth studio album — a short, gospel-focused project reflecting his conversion to born-again Christianity. Recorded alongside his Sunday Service Choir, the album won the Grammy for Best Christian Contemporary Music Album.

comps.name: Yedits Presents: Jesus Is King
comps.description: 3rd installment in the YP series. Contains much grander and cinematic production, topped off with new features. Despite some aspects showing their age, it still holds up greatly and is considered the definitive JIK rework.

comps.name: Palm Springs
comps.description: 7-track comp merging material from Yandhi and Jesus Is King in a seamless way that fits the released project's soundscape. Inspired by the approach taken on Healing with a short, cohesive and spiritual project.

comps.name: Jesus Is King EP
comps.description: EP-length JIK comp based on the work made for a cancelled, much bigger community comp. Contains a few edits expanding on songs of the era while maintaining the minimal sound of the released project.

comps.name: Jesus Is King (Rework)
comps.description: Edits of songs from the JIK era touching up songs to make them fuller, creating a more cohesive album experience while keeping it realistic to what Kanye could have made.

name: JESUS IS KING: The Dr. Dre Version
description: In 2019, Kanye stated that the original plan for Jesus Is King was to have it produced by Dr. Dre, but creative differences led to a different direction. The Dre Version era refers to the alternate sessions that were leaked, featuring a harder, more polished sound than the released album.

comps.name: Jesus Is King: The Dr. Dre Version
comps.description: All JIIK stuff in either highest available quality or upsampled. No production edits, just upsamples. Made with a new upsampling model that works much better than the past ones.

name: God's Country
description: God's Country was a project Kanye worked on throughout 2020, building on the gospel sound of Jesus Is King but incorporating trap elements and a darker aesthetic. Several leaks surfaced during the year giving the community a glimpse of what the album might have sounded like.

comps.name: God's Country (v2.0)
comps.description: Aims to create what a finished GC album would have sounded like if it was released in 2020, albeit with some of Lionel's trap-influenced touches. Every song has been reworked from their original versions. Released with stems.

comps.name: God's Country
comps.description: GC community comp originally envisioned as the V3 to Lionel's GC comp, containing various changes in production, structure and general vibe across every track, forming a well-rounded experience for this unfinished era.

comps.name: God's Country V3
comps.description: GC comp centered upon QoL changes, minor production improvements and several mixing and mastering tweaks to create the most complete yet realistic and release-ready GC album as possible.

comps.name: God's Country
comps.description: GC comp with a choir-heavy soundscape with a lot of dark sonics. Made to be listened from start to finish, due to containing lead ups and transitions to each other. One of the most slept on and underrated GC comps ever.

name: DONDA [V1]
description: DONDA: With Child refers to the early iteration of what would become Donda, featuring OG versions of many released tracks as well as confirmed evolution of Yandhi songs. The era is characterized by a piano-heavy, spiritual sound with numerous guest appearances.

comps.name: DONDA: With Child (Rework)
comps.description: Cohesive DWC comp that envisions release ready versions of songs in the form of many amazing edits with restructures and remasters without huge reworking nor original production, forming a great and focused compilation.

comps.name: DONDA: With Child
comps.description: DWC rework focused on finishing many aspects of the era such as the OG versions of release Donda tracks, confirmed evolutions of Yandhi tracks and a few obscure picks, all to create an insane release-worthy project. One of the most long-awaited comps of all time.

comps.name: DONDA: With Child
comps.description: DWC rework focused a lot more on adding new production and samples that further elevate the songs with fully up-to-date edits and a track selection based on the New Years Day tracklist.

comps.name: DONDA: With Child (CentralDogma Rework)
comps.description: Classic rework of DWC using various songs assembled into one cohesive experience. Features edits from members of the community and many original edits. Despite having some outdated edits, it still holds up extremely well.

name: Donda [V2]
description: Donda V2 refers to a specific stage in the album's development featuring a distinct set of piano-heavy demos and freestyles that Kanye recorded. These tracks have a raw, intimate quality that stands apart from both the earlier DWC sessions and the final released album.

comps.name: Spirits Over The Horizon
comps.description: Extensive rework of the SOTH era. Notably done in a 3 week time period and being outstanding production wise. Created based around the vibe of the piano freestyles and the sound of the Donda album track demos.

comps.name: Orphan V2
comps.description: Dv2 comp focusing on improving rough freestyles with demumbling, restructuring production expanding on the piano-infused demos and more. The most up-to-date Dv2 comp with all the latest material.

comps.name: Donda: Flipside
comps.description: Classic Dv2 rework envisioning what the era was thought to be before the newer info. Merges the more upbeat instruments found in demos of the era with release's finished elements. Contains a great HIII WYD edit.

comps.name: The Seraphim
comps.description: Comp polishing content from the Dv2 era without too much reworking. Made in under 7 days as a challenge. Contains an amazing LOTP edit that's been used as a base for many other edits of the song.

name: Donda [V3]
description: The released version of Donda — Kanye's tenth studio album — came out August 29, 2021 after a prolonged rollout featuring three listening events at the Mercedes-Benz Stadium. At 27 tracks and nearly two hours long, the album was widely seen as bloated but containing many transcendent moments.

comps.name: Spirit Of Donda
comps.description: Donda comp with some DWC songs sprinkled in, filled with amazing reworks (mostly trap-inspired) to create a fresh and sharper version of what we have, opposite of the usual soulful, slow-simmering atmosphere of the era.

comps.name: Donda Ojivolta
comps.description: Donda comp based on soulful singing, the sound of the Dv2 era and Ojivolta's stark, warped production. An interesting take on the era that is simple but very effective as an alternative Donda experience.

comps.name: Donda (uhhjulian Edition)
comps.description: uhhjulian's Donda rework that adds new production and features that don't stray away too far from the released project's material. Contains an iconic Heaven and Hell edit with the Future Sounds beatswitch.

comps.name: Donda: Miracles
comps.description: One of the first successful community comps aside from YP. Contains edits from many members of the community to improve the state of Donda by adding, changing and removing various tracks and elements.

name: Donda 2
description: Donda 2 was released exclusively on Stem Player on February 22, 2022, with Kanye refusing to release it on streaming platforms. A raw, unfinished-sounding record, it was widely panned on release but has found renewed appreciation through the community's extensive editing work.

comps.name: Donda 2 (Beach House Edition / Deluxe)
comps.description: D2 comp where Beach House-inspired production takes center stage, accompanied by warm vintage keyboards, guitars, and the iconic Linn drum machine.

comps.name: Chicago
comps.description: Community comp focused on bringing a finished, updated and expanded look into a variety of released and unreleased material from the Donda 2 era. Contains a great edit reconstructing and finishing Symphonic Blues Suite.

comps.name: Donda 2
comps.description: Personal envisioning of Donda 2 that has been in development since 2022, making an enjoyable listen of the album without overhauls or AI usage.

comps.name: Donda 2
comps.description: SimpleJosh's take on Donda 2, including several QoL edits that restructure the vocals to ensure the least mumble across the whole project and several production changes to improve the listening experience as a whole.

name: WAR
description: WAR was a project Kanye worked on in late 2022, featuring a spacious, ethereal sound with heavy influence from James Blake and electronic music. The era has leaks from multiple sessions and is characterized by its atmospheric, introspective production.

comps.name: WAR
comps.description: Finished version of both Days Dissolve's IT'S WAR and louiebag's WAR, polishing and expanding upon material from both comps. Contains spectacular overhauls of several WAR tracks and entirely new song selections that still retain a sound that's close to that of the source material.

comps.name: WAR
comps.description: A faithful 10 track take on the WAR era with changes such as cutdowns, effects and a few added vocals to flesh out the project while making everything flow seamlessly.

comps.name: WAR
comps.description: Recent comp of this former grail era based on the October 2022 copy, focusing on making it sound mostly finished in a realistic manner with demumbles, cutdowns, restructures, mixing and a bit of added production.

comps.name: Echoes Talking V2
comps.description: Remake of TMNG's original WAR-inspired Kanye x James Blake collab comp taking place in 2023, featuring new tracks and updates of the original, adding up to a nearly entirely different experience from its predecessor.

name: YEBU
description: YEBU refers to a collection of solo Kanye material from around 2022-2023, often sample-based and chill-sounding, predating the VULTURES sessions. Several tracks from this era ended up on VULTURES or were repurposed for other projects.

comps.name: Exiled.
comps.description: Comp envisioning a cohesive solo Ye album set after V1 that is sonically more sample based and chill with change in vibes of each song edited.
Realistic rework of the YEBU era material with creative, polished and touched up edits that don't stray away too much from the original sound.

comps.name: Y3
comps.description: YEBU comp utilizing a multitude songs ranging from D2 to VULTURES, reworking them with restructures, production and vocals to feel like a concise and somewhat realistic envisioning of the era.

comps.name: Y3 V2
comps.description: Sample based reimagining of the YEBU era material. Changes range from QoL touchups, demumbles, new verses, added samples and reproductions. Received a substantial update with better choices on production, vocals and mixing.

comps.name: YESUKE
comps.description: Overhaul of YEBU and VULTURES material in the style of JPEGMAFIA, borrowing influences from ILDMLFY to flesh out Ye's unfinished ideas via new samples, production and features.

name: Bad Bitch Playbook
description: The Bad Bitch Playbook era refers to the development phase of what would become VULTURES, when Kanye and Ty Dolla $ign first began collaborating. The sessions produced a number of tracks with a harder, more club-ready sound before the project transformed into the full VULTURES album.

comps.name: Bad Bitch Playbook
comps.description: Comp merging many aspects present in the ¥$ collabs' development phases in a cohesive way that makes for a complete experience full of bangers.

comps.name: Bad Bitch Playbook Vol. 1
comps.description: Remake of the December 2023 Vultures TL. Contains a mixture of reworks and remasters to put together a finished and cohesive LP.

name: VULTURES
description: Ye and Ty Dolla $ign frequently collaborated during the sessions for YEBU and Beach House 4, hinting at a joint project. A video of Ye and Ty listening to "BACK TO ME" was released on October 2nd, 2023, confirming a joint album via Instagram. TMZ later reported that Ye was producing both a solo album and a collaborative one with Ty. Then, during the Saudi Arabia recording sessions for ¥$ in November 2023, the name for the collaborative project between Ty Dolla $ign and Ye would be changed to VULTURES, with that coming a sonic change in the project.

comps.name: REPENT
comps.description: Insane envisioning of a ¥$ remix album produced by JPEGMAFIA that was released in place of VULTURES 2, incorporating album tracks, features and demos in very unique ways. Manages to capture JPEG's sound perfectly.

comps.name: VULTURES
comps.description: VULTURES comp utilizing various V1 and V2 tracks, reworking and fleshing them out with production and structure changes for a more finished sound. The most concise and refined way to experience the VULTURES material.

comps.name: LIFESTYLE
comps.description: Personal VULTURES take that attempts to make it actually good, with a focus on the pop-leaning songs of this era, turning it into a warm, concise and more lighthearted project inspired by the BBPB/early VULTURES sound.

comps.name: THE VULTURES PROJECT
comps.editor: bobert, bryg, dash, dev, noa, paci
comps.description: Massive 41 track comp divided into 3 acts that encompasses most of the VULTURES material so far, with better mixing and other production choices.

comps.name: ¥$ (Akimbo's Cut)
comps.description: Akimbo's personal cut of multiple edits from his BBPB, V1 and V2 comps as well as few new ones that add/restructure elements from various demos and improve their mixing/mastering, all while being faithful to the original material.

name: VULTURES 1
description: VULTURES 1 was the debut album from ¥$ (Kanye West and Ty Dolla $ign), released February 10, 2024. A divisive release featuring heavy trap production and provocative lyrics, the album debuted at number one despite controversy surrounding its release.

comps.name: VULTURES 1: Dropout Edition
comps.description: Remix of the VULTURES 1 album, replicating the sampley chipmunk soul beats found on Ye's debut solo album, The College Dropout.

comps.name: VULTURES 1 (Akimbo's Cut)
comps.description: Akimbo's cut of songs from VULTURES 1 with a variety of QoL changes both in audio mixing/mastering and the songs' elements.

name: VULTURES 2
description: VULTURES 2 was released June 3, 2024, to a largely negative critical reception. Despite a weaker showing than its predecessor, the album contained several standout tracks and has been extensively reworked by the community to reach its full potential.

comps.name: VULTURES 2 (hc's Version)
comps.description: Personal take on V2, containing reworks of its released songs and scraps from the BBPB era. Deviates off the style the released VULTURES albums had to deliver a more concise and enjoyable experience.

comps.name: VULTURES 2 + DELUXE (Rework)
comps.description: Rework of the released dumpster fire of an album with a variety of reproductions, restructures, audio polishes and straight up overhauls and remakes of some of the project's tracks.

comps.name: VULTURES: Let The Spirits Collide
comps.description: Team effort to rework and improve the VULTURES 2 material with production, vocal and idea additions not usual on other comps of the same era while still retaining correlation with the original sound.

comps.name: VULTURES 2 (March / April Version)
comps.description: louiebag's updated VULTURES 2 comp, serving as a realistic and complete envisioning of the material made for the album between March and April 2024. Mixed and mastered by Akimbo.

name: BULLY
description: BULLY is an upcoming Kanye West album that has been previewed extensively through various live performances, social media posts, and leaks. The project features a diverse sonic palette with both hard-hitting and melodic tracks.

name: Live
description: A collection of the best live performance comps from across Kanye's career — remastered concert recordings, CDQ recreations of tour setlists, and polished edits of official and bootleg live material.

comps.name: Glow In The Dark Tour
comps.description: GITD Tour comp that while not exactly a 1:1 replica of the tour, has additions based on the tour versions. Essentially more like an extended Graduation.

comps.name: Watch The Throne Tour
comps.description: CDQ recreation of the WTT tour material.

comps.name: Yeezus Tour: From Fighting To Finding
comps.description: CDQ recreation of the Yeezus tour.

comps.name: Saint Pablo Tour: Redux
comps.description: A recreation of the Saint Pablo Tour while also having creative liberties to make it greater. Bases off the main setlist for the tour.

name: Other
description: A collection of unique projects that don't fit neatly into a single era — mashup albums, cross-era edits, collaborative imaginations, and other creative works that draw from multiple parts of Kanye's discography.

comps.description: Mashup album made to be sort of an alt universe Kanye project. The songs put together come from all different eras of Kanye's discography. Version linked is the deluxe update released in 2021 that fixes some melodic issues.

comps.name: ClamYe
comps.description: Mashup comp adding Kanye West over various Clams Casino instrumentals. Not era accurate.

comps.name: Donda TV
comps.description: Collection of songs from Kanye's discography, now reworked with new sample-based instrumentals.

comps.name: Dope & Dreams
comps.description: Comp set in an alternate timeline where Ye and Pusha T made an album together. Most of the production is sample-based, combining Pusha's gritty feel with Kanye's soulful elements. Multi-era, with main focus on Wyoming.

comps.name: GriseldYe
comps.description: Comp that reworks many Donda and Donda 2 songs to create a completely new tape in the same style as the Griselda Records, with new original beats. Spectacular talent on here.

comps.name: KANYE MADE TPAB
comps.description: Kendrick Lamar's To Pimp A Butterfly, but all the vocals are from Kanye West songs.
